features.text: PNEUMATIC STABILIZATION: Integrated air bladders add adjustable compression for swelling control and comfort.
CUSTOM COMPRESSION CONTROL: Built in pump and release valve let you fine tune pressure as needed.
BREATHABLE AIRMESH LINER: Ventilated interior improves comfort during extended wear.
ROCKER BOTTOM MOBILITY: Dual axis sole supports a more natural walking motion during recovery.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PDAC APPROVED L4361, L4360: Eligible for insurance reimbursement (check with your provider).
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
